scenarios.requirement: Overlapping active reservations for the same equipment must be rejected atomically.
The return date is exclusive; an adjacent rental may start on that date.
A user cannot read or mutate another workspace's equipment/customers/reservations.
A viewer can read but cannot create or change operational records.
Origin and session-bound CSRF protection are required for writes.
Cancelled reservations release dates; returned reservations cannot be checked out again.
Maintenance equipment cannot be checked out; reservation state transitions are enforced.
Human-facing booking flow preserves inputs on conflict, persists data and handles exact currency.

factory_gate_limit: This manifest maps independent acceptance requirements to real checks. It is not the factory's full deterministic gate implementation or an LLM evaluation.
